name: What is the process for replacing a bathroom countertop?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing a bathroom countertop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing a bathroom countertop involves precision templating, material fabrication, and skilled installation. First, the existing countertop, sinks, and plumbing connections are carefully disconnected and removed. Technicians measure and create a digital or physical template of your vanity base to account for wall irregularities. The selected slab is cut, edged, and prepped with sink and faucet cutouts at a fabrication shop. Finally, installers set the countertop, secure undermount or drop-in sinks, connect the plumbing lines, and seal the edges with silicone to prevent moisture penetration.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves removing the old top, creating a precise template, cutting the slab off-site, setting the new counter and sinks, and reconnecting plumbing fixtures.
